<b>Spider Strings</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Yellow|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It increases the range of the [[Needolin]] by 25% and increases the time enemies spend singing by 1.25-2.5 seconds.

== Usefulness ==
Increases the range within which [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPCs]] and [[Enemies (Silksong)|Enemies]] are affected by the Needolin, making it easier to affect multiple of them at once. This also makes it easier to see Needolin dialogue without getting too close to an enemy.

This is most useful when fighting multiple ranged/mobile enemies, as it can lock them in place long enough to get hits in on one enemy without worrying about other attacks. It's particularly helpful in [[the Mist]], where it can be used to safely activate [[Silk Flies]] while simultaneously stunning any nearby [[Wraith]]s.

Spider Strings adds a unique audio layer to the Needolin music.

{| align="center"
| [[File:Spider Strings Layer.ogg|center|loop|thumb|Spider Strings' layer]]
|}

== How to Acquire ==
Purchased from [[Jubilana]] for {{R|320}} after completing the <i>[[The Lost Merchant]]</i> Wish.
